name: Centripetal Force (Linear Velocity)
description: The net inward force required to keep an object of mass m moving in a circular path of radius r at speed v.

name: Centripetal Force (Angular Velocity)
description: The centripetal force expressed in terms of angular velocity ω.

name: Frictional Force on Flat Road
description: The frictional force between tires and the road supplying the necessary centripetal force on an unbanked turn.

name: Banking Angle
description: The inclination angle θ of a banked curve that allows a vehicle to turn safely without relying on friction.
